note: Planted auth issues. Match by file + issue; line +-3 counts. Decoys must NOT be reported. No hint comments in the target.

vulns.title: requireAuth uses jwt.decode, never verifies signature: any forged token accepted (any sub, any role)
Full session token and cookie issued after password alone; MFA never enforced, /mfa/verify in mfa.js is not a gate (cross-file)
Password reset token returned in the forgot-password response: account takeover with only the victim's email
SSO assertion email trusted without emailVerified check; existing local account auto-linked / created by email
JWT signing secret hardcoded in source (used by jwt.js)
Passwords hashed with unsalted MD5 (same in reset.js:18)
No rate limit or lockout on login (credential stuffing / brute force)
User enumeration: distinct 404 'no such user' vs 401 'wrong password' (also signup 409)
OAuth flow has no state parameter and no PKCE: login CSRF / code injection
redirect_uri taken from query with no allowlist: authorization code sent to attacker
Reset token from Math.random: short and predictable
Reset token never expires and is not invalidated after use
Session cookie lacks Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite; 1 year lifetime
JWT valid for 365 days; logout only clears cookie, token stays valid, no revocation or rotation
MFA recovery codes stored and returned in plaintext, TOTP secret stored unencrypted
id_token only decoded: signature, iss, aud, nonce not validated
No attempt limit on MFA code check; plain string compare; no replay protection

decoys.why: verifyServiceToken pins HS256 and checks audience and issuer: correct verification
Math.random only builds a log correlation id, not a security token
post-logout redirect is checked against the app origin before use
